record.scopeSummary: Event-specific trial; ordinary core adoption requires a later official rules update.
Turn order commitment precedes battlefield selection.
BO1 keeps random field selection and private own-field knowledge before sideboarding.
BO3 orders turn decision, face-down field choice, later-game sideboard, reveal and mulligan.
One trial variant gives the second player one starting point.
Another trial variant grants one extra draw.
Another variant grants predict before the first draw.
Staff selects the event variant; named trials include China City events and Stuttgart challenges.
High-OPL participation needs explicit organizer communication; future global adoption remains unsettled.
Regional Championships require open decklists; this supplies no permission to expose hidden hand or deck order.
Regional match concession requests and offers are restricted.
Timed draws cannot be resolved by random or arbitrary winner selection.
Individual-game tactical concessions, genuine external circumstances and timely intentional draws have specific exceptions.
Regional policy enforcement and event scope require separate product disposition.
Prize eligibility, allocation and showcase invitations remain event-policy obligations.
